given_when_then.given: A Store Partner has submitted a Real-Time Inventory Snapshot with updated stock quantities
given_when_then.when: The system receives the snapshot and performs validation against the central Product Catalog
given_when_then.then: The central Product Catalog is updated with the new quantities and the snapshot is marked as processed

given_when_then.given: The data link latency between Store Partner and system exceeds the defined threshold
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to process the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot
given_when_then.then: The system flags a synchronization discrepancy and does not update the central Product Catalog

given_when_then.given: A synchronization failure is detected in the data link
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to process the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot
given_when_then.then: The system flags a synchronization discrepancy and does not update the central Product Catalog

success_criteria: Real-Time Inventory Snapshots from Store Partners are validated and the central Product Catalog is updated correctly
Synchronization discrepancies are flagged when data link latency exceeds the defined threshold
Synchronization discrepancies are flagged when a sync failure is detected
Stock quantities are validated before updating the central Product Catalog
The system handles receipt of Real-Time Inventory Snapshots without blocking other valid updates due to single sync failures
